dispositions.reason: Kaiser et al. 4/5 three-perfect-matching coverage for all bridgeless cubic graphs is a long-standing problem closely tied to Berge-Fulkerson. Not a screening target.

Search snippet: still open per source.

dispositions.title: Order-7 spiral optimality conjecture for fixed vertex number
dispositions.reason: Spiral optimality among penny graphs of all distances for every n (verified n<=366536). Needs global extremal geometry; no short mechanism.

dispositions.title: The exact L(3,2,1)-labeling number of a 4-valent circulant with steps 1 and 3
dispositions.reason: Finite certificate candidate (briefs/372627.md). For n>=19 the span-11 L(3,2,1)-labelings of C_n(1,3) are exactly closed walks in a 152-state window graph whose only nontrivial SCCs are two 12-cycles (f(i)=c+5i or c+7i mod 12), forcing 12|n. The 11-label graph is acyclic. With the source's Theorem 6 (=11 when 12|n) and Theorem 10 (<=12 for even n>=142, also independently replayed with a 13-label closed-walk check), this gives the full statement. Source body read (Holub-Kopriva arXiv 2601.12574v2, Conjecture 11).
dispositions.proof_body_applicability: complete computer-certificate proof here (lower and upper bound); review pending

dispositions.title: The exact L(3,2,1)-labeling number of odd 4-valent circulants with steps 1 and 5
dispositions.reason: Finite certificate candidate (briefs/372628.md). With labels 0..13, the 110,672-state window graph of C_n(1,5) has only even-period SCCs (periods 2, 12 and 14), so there is no odd closed walk and no span-13 labeling for odd n>=31. With the source's Theorem 24 (<=14 for odd n>=105) this gives lambda=14. Source body read (Conjecture 25). The independent 15-label upper-bound replay failed under the memory cap.

dispositions.title: Distinct spectral radii for Type 5 digraphs
dispositions.reason: Distinct roots for distinct admissible triples for all n>=5 (verified n<=200). No full mechanism found; not computed.
